req.title: Return all players sorted by id
req.statement: The system shall list players in insertion (id) order on GET /players/.
triggers: return all players sorted by id

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return all players sorted by their insertion order (id) when a GET request is made to /players/. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct sorting, a negative test to handle client errors, and a boundary test to ensure correct behavior at the edge of the dataset.

tests.name: test_get_all_players_sorted_by_id
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with 26 players.
expected: The players are returned in the order of their ids as per the pre-loaded data.

tests.name: test_get_players_client_error
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with 26 players.
actions: Send a GET request to /players/ with an invalid query parameter.
expected: The response status code is 422 indicating a client error.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/?invalid_param=1')
assert response.status_code == 422

tests.name: test_get_all_players_boundary_case
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with 26 players.
expected: The first and last players in the response match the expected boundary players.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/')
assert response.status_code == 200
players = response.json()
assert len(players) == 26
assert players[0]['id'] == "5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d0"
assert players[-1]['id'] == "da31293b-4c7e-5e0f-a168-469ee29ecbc4"
